blocking_findings.detail: After actual private menu launch, _launch can return null for a later context/health audit. run assigns this null to battle. finish only frees battle, so the actual already-created caller scene is not explicitly released.

The only Session owning the original pending write token is a local saver. save_held may return pending_save/unsafe/restart_required; _save immediately returns and drops that original Session. This is a failure cleanup/diagnostic issue; it does not make a pending write a successful save.

outside_A_scope_findings.detail: Session.commit_restore_async hands the exact Battle/identity to caller; subsequent held/packet/world audits may return null before run assigns battle. Session.dispose installed phase does not free caller world. Same own pointer correction needed before these postcommit checks.

normal_route_static_conclusions: The only player commands are actual select_members plus minimap_order at fixed original mission/gate/prison/exit cells; no position, hp, progress, Mission callback, resolve_story or win injection.

Real prison rescue uses original admission/fire/gate/rescue tasks. First role is lu or shi; _crew FIELD_KEYS excludes Lu Junyi and Shi Xiu, so the other rescued actor receives no exit order. Single-safe predicate requires the original other actor alive/root-active/empty outcome and no second-safe/victory event.

Actual Unit.resolve_story sets retreated, calls order_stop, and establishes chase_intent=0/group_cap=0.0/home=position/has_home=true/hua_lock_shots=0, then emits the original story signal. Route waits a completed ordinary process observation and actual healthy HELD; no test-side stop field patch is required.

Original Battle story callback clears selection/casters/cast queues before Level mission safe mark. The A report/control/callback and full Session.save_held/disk generation/context/pause checks remain meaningful original checks.
Actual _hold cleans only its own exact callbacks before and after request and waits genuine paused draining/clock health. No repeated one-shot rejected-listener leak in this v25s helper.
limitations: Static route/API closure does not prove natural combat/path/cover/survival or successful save. Native first-Lu and first-Shi source routes must genuinely pass.
Only A is this execution review scope; no full B/C/D, negative matrix, public continue or Steam qualification is granted.
disposition: Preserve this old runner and review. Use a new immutable sibling with explicit own launched/committed Battle and retained original pending save Session, then obtain independent review of that new source.
